name: PVEDamageGuard
title: PVE Damage Guard
author: Gabriel Dungan (DunganSoft Technologies)
description: Future-proof Rust NPC classifier, per-attacker damage scaling, and reflect-as-a-service for PVE servers. TruePVE companion.

permissions.name: pvedamageguard.admin
permissions.description: Use the /pdg admin commands and the in-game CUI admin panel.

permissions.name: pvedamageguard.bypass
permissions.description: Exempt the holder from PVE Damage Guard's damage rules.

commands.description: Admin: status, config reload/validate, recent-log tail, classification test, and the CUI admin panel.
